scope: Existing 61,407 context building objects; mixed-date snapshots, not a complete current Vancouver census.
footprintMethod: Original source-derived mesh XY silhouettes, concavities/holes retained; exact footprint/cone intersections.
provenance: City of Vancouver view boundaries and raw observer elevations; context building geometry and heights from OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL; approximate SRTM context.

study.label: Hypothetical view-height study
study.planeAssumption: level plane at raw observer elevation
study.groundAssumption: illustrative flat ground, assumed common reference with raw observer elevation
study.baseline: existing model building height; NOT parcel zoning height
study.displayTop: original model base Z plus hypothetical height; display translation only
study.outsideBehavior: existing height retained; no mapped-view restriction inferred from loaded corridors
